anomalies.description: A person in a beige coat (customer) appears to be concealing an item under their coat while standing near shelves; simultaneously, the cashier (in blue shirt and checkered cap) stands up abruptly and leans forward toward the counter, possibly reacting to suspicious behavior. The customer’s posture and hand placement suggest concealment consistent with shoplifting. No clear weapon or violence, but the combination of concealment attempt and cashier’s reactive movement indicates suspicious activity.

A person in a beige coat (customer) appears to be concealing an item under their coat while standing near shelves; they then move toward the counter area without placing the item on the counter or interacting with the cashier. The person in pink (possibly another customer or accomplice) stands close by, partially obstructing view. The cashier remains seated and does not appear to observe the action. This behavior is consistent with shoplifting via concealment.
